reference_id.description: A unique, randomly generated hex value that identifies your web service request.

sub_resource.description: The name of the subresource accessed.

errors.description: Contains an object for each error condition that resulted from the request.

items.description: Contains properties related to an error that occurred during processing of the request.

code.description: A one to five-digit error code (possibly negative) that indicates the type of error that occurred.

description.description: A description of the type of error that occurred.

status.description: Contains details about the request status.

code.description:
A numeric code indicating the processing status of this request.
 
| Value | Description | 
|-------|-------------| 
| 2400 | Pending | 
| 2401 | Success | 
| 2402 | Failure | 
| 2403 | Not Attempted | 
| 2404 | Invalid Phone Number | 
| 2405 | Not Supported | 
| 2407 | CallerID prefix did not match | 
| 2408 | Unsupported phone type | 
| 2409 | Verification call not received |
| 2410 | Please retry verification |
| 2411 | Verification call failed |
| 2429 | Call blocked by customer request | 
| 2430 | Call blocked by Telesign |

updated_on.description: An [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) timestamp indicating when the transaction status was updated.
